task_text: Append a new L2 VLAN entry with id 90 and name 'VLAN90' to the l2vlans list of the first tenant. Use AVD l2vlans schema: {id: 90, name: 'VLAN90'}. This will provision VLAN 90 on all leaf nodes that are members of this tenant.
reasoning: VLANs for leaf nodes are defined in network_services.yml under tenants; a plain VLAN with no SVI/routing requirement belongs in the tenant's l2vlans list.
